decision: Reopen the same norm-to-dynamic-E4M3 scientific question for one source-level causal correction. The measured candidate is physically positive but semantically rejected; derive and reproduce the pinned stock RMSNorm and quantization operation order before any further target-GPU request.

evidence.physical_signal: The rejected candidate removed one producer launch and reduced the measured producer-plus-real-QKV-consumer median by 13.0% at M=16 and 14.9% at M=32. These timings do not transfer to a corrected candidate.

scientific_contract.question: Can a fused pre-attention RMSNorm-to-dynamic-E4M3 producer reproduce the exact pinned stock activation bytes and per-row scales while retaining the measured launch-elimination mechanism for decode M<=32?
required_work: Trace the exact pinned stock RMSNorm and dynamic-E4M3 CUDA producers, including BF16 conversion points, accumulation precision, lane-to-element mapping, reduction tree, amax reduction, scale arithmetic, E4M3 conversion, and zero-row behavior.
Use deterministic differential CPU or source-level simulation to localize the first divergent intermediate for M=1,16,32 on adversarial finite inputs and the retained loaded-activation evidence.
Implement one corrected source candidate only if the exact operation order can be stated and reproduced. Preserve stock fallback for M>32 and all non-bound shapes or dtypes.

Prove exact activation bytes and exact FP32 scale bytes against the stock reference on the complete deterministic corpus. Approximate L2, cosine, or tolerance-only evidence is insufficient for promotion.

Update the H200 physical/resource falsifier for the corrected source: compile-time register/shared-memory expectations, 132-SM wave geometry, bytes, launches, and the unchanged real QKV consumer contract.
Publish MECHANISM_REPAIR_TERMINAL.json with either source_complete_exact_candidate or typed_exactness_negative. Do not request or run a GPU in this cycle.
closed_paths: Do not rerun or relabel the existing c24c5a90... candidate.
Do not reopen the residual-fed pre-MLP or M=2048 prefill variants.
Do not weaken exactness to the prior finite tolerance.
Do not broaden into endpoint integration, quality evaluation, generic fusion survey, or provider preparation.
scientific_contract.promotion_gate: A later director may nominate one exact-consumer H200 test only if the corrected source, full deterministic exact-byte oracle, pinned consumer contract, and physical falsifier are all durable. No timing from the rejected candidate may be claimed for the corrected source.
